notes.title: 🧹 Devlog #3 - September
notes.content:
🧹 Playtest Has Ended – Thank You!
Hello everyone!

The Playtest of Cleaning Simulator has officially come to an end. We would like to sincerely thank all the players who tried the game, shared their feedback, and helped us improve. 🙏
[hr][/hr]💬 Player Feedback
During the Playtest, you provided us with valuable insights about:

Gameplay mechanics

Camera and controls

The overall experience

These contributions will play a major role in shaping the future of the game.
[hr][/hr]🚀 Next Step: Demo Version
While the Playtest has ended, we have exciting news:

The demo version will be available very soon!

You’ll be able to experience the first levels in a more stable and optimized build.

Many of the improvements based on your feedback will be included in the demo.
[hr][/hr]🙌 Thank You
Your support and participation mean a lot to us. Together, we’re making Cleaning Simulator better.

🧹 See you in the demo! ✨





— The Cleaning Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: 🧹 Devlog #2 - August
notes.content:
🧹 Cleaning Simulator Playtest is Live!


Hello everyone! ✨

A while ago, we announced our partnership with RockGame. Now, we’re excited to share another big step in our journey: the Playtest version of Cleaning Simulator is available now! 🚀



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584891/b5f5230febde02225aaf56f136149e406a0f0cb9.png"]
🧽 What’s Included in This Version?
🏠 Play the first tasks and experience the cleaning mechanics.

🎮 Test the controls and get a feel for the atmosphere.

💬 Share your feedback and directly contribute to the development process.


❓ Why a Playtest?
This Playtest allows us to share an early stage of the game with players and learn more about:

🕹️ How smooth the controls feel

🔧 How clear and functional the mechanics are

🌍 The overall gameplay experience


🔑 How to Join
Joining the Playtest is easy:
[olist]
Go to our Steam page 👉 Cleaning Simulator

Click the “Request Access” button.

Once access is granted, download the build and start playing!
[/olist]

💡 What We Expect From You
🐞 Report any bugs or issues you encounter.

📝 Share your thoughts about the gameplay.

🚀 Give us suggestions on how to improve the experience.


🙌 Thank You
Thank you in advance for joining this Playtest. Your feedback is valuable and will help shape the future of Cleaning Simulator.



🧹 Let’s make the game shine together! ✨







— The Cleaning Simulator Dev Team
